name: City Builder — Datapolis
tagline: Become the Mayor of a floating retro-cyberpunk city. Rebuild its Data Warehouse, district by district, until you earn the rank of Grid Keeper.
description: 🏙️ Datapolis floats above the wastelands on an anti-gravity platform called The Grid. You are the newly elected Mayor, and your predecessor sabotaged the municipal Data Warehouse before fleeing. Reconstruct 7 city districts + the boss city-wide BI dashboard by writing T-SQL in Datapolis_DW and DAX in Datapolis_Model. Each district teaches a dimensional-modeling concept. The Mayor notebook validates your work via INFORMATION_SCHEMA + XMLA, emits events to an Eventhouse, and the Dashboard tracks your reputation.
learning_objectives: Distinguish facts from dimensions and choose the correct grain
Design surrogate keys and apply SCD Type 1
Implement conformed dimensions reused across multiple facts
Resolve many-to-many relationships with bridge tables
Assemble a galaxy schema and tune its DAX performance

items.name: Datapolis_LH
items.description: Raw + Blueprint datasets used by the Mayor to validate the warehouse build.

items.name: Datapolis_DW
items.description: Mostly empty — the player creates Fact*/Dim* via T-SQL. Ships with a `demo` schema (DimColor + FactExample) as a worked example.

items.name: Datapolis_EH
items.description: Mayor telemetry: districts attempted/built, reputation, DAX validation results.

items.name: CityBuilder_Seed
items.description: Run once. Generates raw + Blueprint Delta tables in Datapolis_LH using PySpark.

items.name: CityBuilder_Mayor
items.description: Briefings + Mayor class. mayor.inspect_district('town-hall') validates schema + DAX, emits events.

items.name: CityBuilder_Dashboard
items.description: Datapolis city map + reputation + DAX scoreboard. Reads CityEvents.

districts.name: Town Hall — Phantom Census
districts.narrative: After the '99 archive fire only one corrupted tape survived: a dump where citizen attributes and life events are mixed on the same rows. Separate them.

districts.name: Neon District — Shifting Identities
districts.narrative: Citizens legally rename after augmentation; source overwrites with no history. Build DimResident with a surrogate key and update-in-place semantics.

districts.name: Skylane — Anti-Grav Couriers
districts.narrative: 80k cargo / medevac flights across sectors. Build FactFlight + conformed DimDate + DimSector (reused later).

districts.name: Plasma Core — Reactor Readings
districts.narrative: Hourly snapshots of pressure / temperature / MW output. Summing is meaningless — AVERAGE the pressure.

districts.name: Bazaar 9 — The Quantum Market
districts.narrative: Sales travel two timelines: OrderDate and DeliveryDate (sometimes earlier for pre-cog VIPs). Link FactSale twice to DimDate; use USERELATIONSHIP.

districts.name: Cryo Hospital — Admission Tags
districts.narrative: 4 boolean flags collapsed into a 16-row junk DimAdmissionType; CryoTicketNumber is a degenerate dim living on the fact.

districts.name: Holo-Stage — Multiverse Performers
districts.narrative: Artists perform in multiple shows; shows feature multiple artists. Build DimArtist, DimShow, FactShow, BridgeShowArtist. Watch fan-out.

districts.name: The Grid Overlook — BOSS: The Anomaly
districts.narrative: A gravitational anomaly is destabilizing the platform. Build a director dashboard blending FactFlight + FactReactorReading + FactSale through shared dims; Grid Stress Index must run < 2s.

demo_kit.purpose: Worked Dim/Fact example pre-loaded in Datapolis_DW so the player can inspect the pattern, then drop the schema before District 1.
